newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 1996 GNP growth 6.8 pct vs pvs 5.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 1996 GNP growth 6.8 pct vs pvs 5.0 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' gross national product (GNP) grew by 6.8 percent in 1996 against 5.0 percent in the previous year, the National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) said on Wednesday.
The country's gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 5.5 percent in 1996 compared to a 4.8 percent growth in 1995, NEDA said.
GNP growth in the fourth quarter of 1996 was at 6.2 percent compared to 4.9 percent in the year-ago period.
GDP growth in the fourth quarter of 1996 was at 5.2 percent versus a 4.4 percent growth in the year-ago period, NEDA said.
